title: Kingy Local AI Scoreboard
cite: Kingy AI, Kingy Local AI Scoreboard, https://kingy.ai/local-ai-scoreboard/

scores.csv.job_set: always 0.3 in this file (job set 0.2 is in job-set-0.2/)
scores.csv.model: model name as shown on the page
scores.csv.model_id: stable Kingy id for the model file
scores.csv.machine_id: stable Kingy id for the machine
scores.csv.rented: yes when the card was rented by the hour (RunPod)
scores.csv.file_size_gb: file size in GB (1 GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes)
scores.csv.file_sha256_first12: first 12 characters of the file SHA-256
scores.csv.score: THE SCORE: average of the nine job scores, 0 to 100
scores.csv.lucy_group: tie group on the Lucy AI Studio board; empty on rented cards
scores.csv.job_<id>: job score: share of hidden checks passed, averaged over three runs (job ids are in jobs.csv)
scores.csv.writing_time_hours: total model writing time for all 27 runs
scores.csv.tokens_per_second: all tokens written divided by total writing time, from llama.cpp timing
scores.csv.replies_cut_off: replies that hit the length limit before finishing
scores.csv.card_memory_peak_gib / card_memory_total: rented RTX 5080 and RTX 4070 Ti only: peak graphics memory used (nvidia-smi) and the card's total

runs.csv.checks_passed: hidden checks passed in that run
runs.csv.checks_total: hidden checks in that job version

jobs.csv.job_set / job_id / job / group: job id, name and kind (Build, Think, Create)
jobs.csv.job_version: version of the job and its checks
jobs.csv.counted_in_score: all nine count on job set 0.3
jobs.csv.best_to_worst_gap / normal_swing_between: whether the gap across the Lucy files is at least 10 points and at least twice the normal swing between a model's own runs

blender.csv.(unchanged): the separate Blender job, job set 0.2, eight models x 3 runs; never in the score. Fields as in job-set-0.2/README.md
